column3: Close to the Hebrew; “Hallelujah” is rendered “Praise the LORD!” and בְּסוֹד (“in the council”) “In the assembly.”
Close to the Hebrew; הוֹד־ (“splendor”) is rendered “honorable.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he has made a remembrance of his wonders” is rendered “He has made His wonderful works to be remembered.”
Close to the Hebrew; אֱמֶת (“truth”) is rendered “verity.”
Close to the Hebrew; סְמוּכִים (“upheld”) is rendered “They stand fast.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “His commandments” for “them.”
